title: Bacon-Wrapped Asparagus
description:
This bacon- wrapped asparagus recipe in the oven includes tips to make it extra crispy. Asparagus wrapped in bacon takes less than 30 minutes!
At Christmas, it’s known as Angelic Asparagus Swaddled With Bacon
directions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (204 degrees C).
Place an oven-safe wire rack (either greased or non-stick) onto a cookie sheet.
Trim the woody ends of the asparagus. Drizzle with olive oil. Sprinkle with garlic salt and black pepper to taste. (You don't need a lot of oil, just enough for the salt and pepper to stick.)
Cut the bacon slices lengthwise to make narrower strips.

Wrap each bacon strip tightly around an asparagus stalk, only slightly overlapping the bacon on each stalk (it will shrink during cooking, creating a "striped" pattern). Place seam side down onto the wire rack.
Use tongs to turn over. Bake for 5-10 minutes more, until the bacon is almost crispy.
Set the oven to broil, then place under the broiler for 1-2 minutes to crisp up more.
